תא שמע דאמר רבי אבהו לא למדה ר' אליעזר אלא מלולב איכא דאמרי ר' אבהו גמרא גמיר לה ואיכא דאמרי מתניתא שמיע ליה

findings.interpretation: Eliezer expressly permits mention throughout the year by analogy with resurrection; the editorial answer on Yehoshua’s behalf distinguishes resurrection, always timely, from out-of-season rain. The Mishnah rejoinder at 2a:2 must not become Yehoshua’s positive year-round ruling.

findings.interpretation: Rabbi Asi transmits Rabbi Yohanan’s halacha as Yehuda. Initial challenge cites Rabbi Elazar for Rabban Gamliel; anonymous answers distinguish different authorities, then request versus mention, then place, finally Temple-present versus absent for the same locale. These are successive proposals, not all simultaneous established distinctions.

evidence.quote: א"ר אסי א"ר יוחנן הלכה כר' יהודה א"ל ר' זירא לר' אסי ומי אמר רבי יוחנן הכי והתנן בשלשה במרחשוון שואלין את הגשמים רבן גמליאל אומר בשבעה בו וא"ר אלעזר הלכה כרבן גמליאל

findings.interpretation: Two festival days: Rav initially starts at musaf, stops at minha/evening/morning then resumes musaf; Shmuel objects to making holy profane and includes minha before stopping. Rava and Rav Sheshet say never stop after beginning. Rav explicitly retracts, transmitted by Rav Hananel in Rav’s name; the concluding halakha is never to stop. The initial Rav–Shmuel disagreement is historical, not Rav’s final stance.
